dct_title_s: Points of Interest of Burkina Faso
dct_description_sm: Points of interest: public-facing amenities, shops, tourist attractions, and landmarks tagged via `amenity`, `shop`, `tourism`, or `man_made`. Useful for general POI reference, urban analysis, and basemap detail. Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org), a free, collaborative world map - Tags: [amenity](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity), [shop](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:shop), [tourism](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:tourism), [man_made](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:man_made) - Part of the [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot/) by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)
